title: IREFOX Profound Gravel review (2023 sample), rechecked
notes: The 2023 Profound 400 review sample uses Shimano 105 R7000 mechanical 2×11, a 50/34T crank, a SunRace 34T cassette cog and Schwalbe 700×40C tires; the reviewer says the bike supports a maximum 40C. The review does not state the cassette's small cog or full range. The tire limit is a reviewer report for the tested sample, not a manufacturer clearance specification or a guarantee for other builds.
